releaseNotes: Dropped-transport mid-scan is now reported honestly as incomplete_transport instead of unreachable-modules, and retries once after a confirmed automatic reconnect
Force-poll cooldowns and confirmed-unsupported PID evidence now survive an automatic reconnect instead of being reset
Confirmed-unsupported PIDs are forwarded into the drive log's unavailable_pids.ndjson, deduplicated per drive
A worse PRE retry result can no longer replace admissible first-attempt evidence; both attempts remain in the exported log either way
